title: CAT 2025 Question Paper (Slot 1, PYQ) - Quantitative Aptitude - Permutation and Combination
subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.q: A cafeteria offers 5 types of sandwiches. Moreover, for each type of sandwich, a customer can choose one of 4 breads and opt for either small or large sized sandwich. Optionally, the customer may also add up to 2 out of 6 available sauces. The number of different ways in which an order can be placed for a sandwich, is
questions.explain:
Type choices = $5$.
Bread choices = $4$.
Size choices = $2$.
Sauces choices (choose 0, 1, or 2 from 6):
$\binom{6}{0} + \binom{6}{1} + \binom{6}{2} = 1 + 6 + 15 = 22$ ways.
Total possible sandwich combinations = $5 \times 4 \times 2 \times 22 = 40 \times 22 = 880$.
